items.question: What is Matrika Homoeopathy?
items.answer: Matrika Homoeopathy provides online consultations with Dr. Pujaa Scinde (BHMS), with an emphasis on individualized assessment and patient-centred communication.

items.question: Do you offer physical consultations?
items.answer: No. All consultations are conducted online. We do not currently offer in-clinic appointments.

items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: You can contact us through our website or WhatsApp. We will share available appointment times, the consultation fee, and booking instructions.

items.question: Will I receive a prescription?
items.answer: A digital prescription may be provided after the consultation if clinically appropriate and permitted under applicable professional requirements.

items.question: Do you provide medicines?
items.answer: No. We do not sell, dispense, or ship medicines. Patients purchase prescribed medicines independently from a reputable pharmacy or authorized supplier.

items.question: Are medicines included in the consultation fee?
items.answer: No. The consultation fee covers the consultation service only. Medicine costs and any delivery or pharmacy charges are separate.

items.question: Can I consult for chronic health concerns?
items.answer: You may discuss long-standing concerns during an online consultation. Some conditions require an in-person examination, diagnostic tests, or specialist assessment.

items.question: Do you provide follow-ups?
items.answer: Yes, follow-ups may be arranged depending on your needs. Applicable fees and appointment details will be communicated in advance.

items.question: Can I continue my existing treatment?
items.answer: Please disclose all current medicines and treatments. Do not discontinue or change prescribed medication without consulting the healthcare professional responsible for your care.

items.question: Is my information confidential?
items.answer: We handle consultation information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements. Please share sensitive medical information only through designated channels.

items.question: Can I consult from another city or state?
items.answer: Eligibility depends on your location and applicable professional requirements. Please share your location when booking so that eligibility can be confirmed.

items.question: What if I have a medical emergency?
items.answer: Online consultations are not intended for emergencies. Seek immediate medical attention for severe or urgent symptoms.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: Results vary according to the condition and individual circumstances. No specific outcome or recovery timeline can be guaranteed.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: Use the WhatsApp button or contact form on our website for booking enquiries and consultation information.
